questions.q: How did Jim feel right after he escaped from Long John into the island?
choices: Pleased, and he began to enjoy exploring
Terrified and ready to go back to the ship
Angry at the captain for letting him go
Sad, lonely, and missing his mother
questions.evidence: I now felt for the first time the joy of exploration

questions.q: What did Jim not realize about the snake that hissed at him?
choices: It was a deadly rattlesnake
It was someone's tame pet
It was only a harmless lizard
It was guarding the treasure
questions.evidence: Little did I suppose that he was a deadly enemy and that the noise was the famous rattle

questions.q: How did Jim know that some of his shipmates were coming near?
choices: A cloud of birds rose screaming from the marsh
He heard a musket fired somewhere in the woods nearby
He saw smoke rising from a cooking fire
He found fresh footprints in the sand
questions.evidence: a great cloud of birds hung screaming and circling in the air

questions.q: Where did Jim hide when he first heard the voices?
choices: Under the nearest live-oak
Inside a hollow log
Up in a tall pine tree
In the cold river
questions.evidence: I crawled under cover of the nearest live-oak

questions.q: Why did Jim decide to crawl closer to Silver and the other man?
choices: He felt it was his duty to overhear their plans
He wanted to ask Silver for something to eat and drink
He had decided to give himself up to them
He thought they had found the treasure
questions.evidence: my plain and obvious duty was to draw as close as I could manage

questions.q: Who was Silver talking with in the little green dell?
choices: Tom, one of the honest sailors
Captain Smollett
Anderson, the boatswain
Ben Gunn, the man who was marooned
questions.evidence: where'd I be, Tom--now, tell me, where'd I be?

questions.q: What did Tom say he would rather do than turn against his duty?
choices: Lose his hand
Leave the sea forever
Give up his share of gold
Swim back to England

questions.q: What interrupted the talk between Silver and Tom?
choices: An angry cry and a long, horrid scream from the marsh
A cannon shot fired from the ship in the anchorage
Jim sneezing loudly in the bushes nearby
A sudden thunderstorm rolling over the hills

questions.q: When Silver said the scream was probably "Alan," what did Tom understand?
choices: That the pirates had killed Alan, an honest seaman
That Alan had found the treasure and was shouting for joy
That Alan had been bitten by a snake in the marsh
That Alan was calling for help with the boats

questions.q: What did Tom do after refusing to be Silver's mate any more?
choices: Turned his back on Silver and walked toward the beach
Pulled out a knife and attacked Silver
Fell on his knees and begged Silver for mercy
Ran off into the swamp to hide among the tall green reeds
questions.evidence: turned his back directly on the cook and set off walking for the beach

questions.q: What did Silver throw to knock Tom down?
choices: His crutch
His knife
A big rock
His hat
questions.evidence: whipped the crutch out of his armpit

questions.q: "The monster had pulled himself together... cleansing his blood-stained knife." Here "cleansing" means:
choices: Wiping clean
Sharpening
Hiding away
Breaking
questions.evidence: cleansing his blood-stained knife the while upon a wisp of grass

questions.q: What did Silver do right after killing Tom that frightened Jim into running?
choices: He blew several blasts on a whistle
He fired his pistol into the air
He shouted Jim's name into the trees
He started digging a grave
questions.evidence: brought out a whistle, and blew upon it several modulated blasts

questions.q: What is the main event of this chapter?
choices: Jim secretly sees Silver murder Tom, an honest sailor, and flees
Jim makes friends with Silver while they explore the island together
Jim finds the stockade and meets the doctor and the squire there
The pirates and the cabin party fight a battle on board the ship
questions.evidence: I could scarce persuade myself that murder had been actually done
